description: Canonical 16-keypoint foot model with reference dimensions

coordinate_system.z_axis: Forward: unit(toe_tip - heel_back) projected to floor plane
coordinate_system.note: For right foot: +X points medial (big-toe side). For left foot: +X points lateral (little-toe side). DO NOT negate axes to fix mirrored foot.

keypoints_mm.name: toe_ground
keypoints_mm.description: Inferior contact point under toe box

keypoints_mm.name: heel_ground
keypoints_mm.description: Origin: Inferior ground contact of calcaneus

keypoints_mm.name: ball_top
keypoints_mm.description: Superior dorsal point over metatarsal heads

keypoints_mm.name: instep_top
keypoints_mm.description: Apex of the dorsal instep arch

keypoints_mm.name: toe_tip
keypoints_mm.description: Anterior tip of Big Toe (MOST IMPORTANT)

keypoints_mm.name: shin_mid
keypoints_mm.description: Anterior lower tibia midpoint (120mm proximal to ankle_center)

scaling_rule.note: Multiply all keypoint coordinates by scale_factor to adapt to different foot sizes

visibility_convention.0: Not labeled / outside frame → excluded from ALL loss
visibility_convention.1: Covered (sock, trouser, shoe) → position supervised, visibility=NEGATIVE
visibility_convention.2: Visible and unoccluded → position supervised, visibility=POSITIVE

tier_convention.tier_1: Primary keypoints (14 total) - always labeled first
tier_convention.tier_2: Secondary keypoints (2 total: arch_medial, midfoot_lateral) - may have v=0 in early passes
